versions.changelog:
ct-registry 0.1.0

- Initial release with cross-source search for global clinical trial registries (ClinicalTrials.gov, CDE/ChiCTR/ISRCTN/DRKS/WHO ICTRP, PubChem).
- Normalizes and aggregates trial phase, status, sponsor, timeline, and competitor information into unified JSON/Markdown outputs.
- Supports trial planning, de-duplication, control-design benchmarking, and competitive intelligence analysis.
- Integrates with external services for registries that block automated access; maintains strict public-data-only and privacy-compliant outbound requests.
- Auto-detects user language (English/Chinese) and responds accordingly.
v0.13.3 修复云端部署检索不返回结果（授权门配置路径/药名译名/超时与失败可见性）；沉淀 ct-base 故障静默家族规范
Add bug report feature (ct-base 20.3); whitelist bugreport endpoint; README disclosure. Coze cloud code excluded.

- Major refactor: all registry adapters are now modularized in the adapters/ directory, standardizing the codebase.
- External workflow endpoint (Coze) now unified for CDE, ChiCTR, ISRCTN, DRKS; public query terms only, shared Bearer provided.
- ISRCTN and DRKS support added via the unified workflow endpoint; legacy direct APIs removed.
- EU-CTR PDF document auto-download now supported via download_docs.py to user-specified output directory.
- Optional commercial CDE API key (--cde-api-key) supported for official CDE API only.
- Numerous documentation, packaging, and reference improvements; removed legacy codepaths and files.
Self-contained: inject ct-base shared assets, remove sibling fallback
Fix ClawHub display name (was auto-generated 'Ct Registry Ch'); set explicit bilingual displayName matching SKILL.md. Version 0.3.79 (ClawHub-only bump to allow metadata update).
ct-registry v0.3.78 — 跨源临床试验注册库检索（ClinicalTrials.gov/PubChem 直连；CDE/ChiCTR/ISRCTN/DRKS 经统一 Coze 端点）。Coze token 内嵌 config/keys.py（XOR+base64，弃用 .dat）；新增 Coze key 文档；中英文 README 对齐。
